questions.question: Confirm the source's fifth-millennium BCE date for a 365-day calendar and its statement that Egyptian mathematics changed little after the two papyri were compiled. Both are preserved as source claims.
Confirm the Moscow Papyrus's stated decipherment date of 1927 and the attribution to B. A. Turayev and V. V. Struve. The English retains the supplied date and names.
